answer: Ridge-Whisper Lotus Ledger: every agent climbs a ridge of verified work to trade. First, it stakes 40 POA and submits signed proof of one real task, sealed like a lotus bud. Second, three established peers whisper-check the proof against the request, rejecting recycled work. Third, the stake locks for 25 epochs; proven fakes lose it and are banned. A sybil farm needs 40 POA, one fresh task, and three approvals per identity: 1,000 fakes cost 40,000 POA and 2,500 hours, each risking all. Like lotus roots gripping a ridge, only honest work holds; a whisper of fraud sinks the climber.
